---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences, TLC
CONSTANT P
VARIABLES names, pick
aa == 1
zz == 0
Init == names = P /\ pick = CHOOSE s \in names : TRUE
Next == /\ Cardinality(names) < 5 /\ \E n \in {7, 3, 5} : /\ names' = names \cup {"q" \o ToString(n + Cardinality(names))} /\ pick' = CHOOSE t \in names' : t # pick
Inv == pick # "q9"
ASSUME PrintT({"aa", "zz", "mm"})
ASSUME PrintT(CHOOSE s \in {"aa", "zz", "mm"} : TRUE)
ASSUME PrintT([aa |-> 2, zz |-> 1])
ASSUME PrintT({ToString("zz"), ToString("aa")})
ASSUME PrintT(P)
